name: Ecuador, Cevallos estimate
locator: Printed p. 32, Población.
method: published historical population estimate
definition: The Bureau dates Cevallos's estimate to 1889. Cevallos used the 1826 return, ministry reports through 1887 and his own information and judgment. The reference day is unknown. The 16 source rows sum to the published total. The opening map perimeter remains unresolved.

name: Oriente
locator: Printed pp. 32–33, Oriente row and accompanying explanation.
method: printed component of a published historical estimate
definition: Rounded estimate for the historical eastern territory. Cevallos cites 39,796 in 1858 as his starting point. The opening boundary cannot be recovered from the published population data.

name: Ecuador, Chicago exposition estimate
locator: Printed p. 367, Población.
method: published historical population estimate
definition: The year is the publication year. The reference date is unknown. The estimate is based on assorted official documents and covers the source's reported territorial scope. The 16 source entries sum to the national estimate.

name: Ecuador, Paris exposition estimate
locator: Ecuador, Population, headline estimate attributed to the official Paris exhibition publication.
method: published historical population estimate
definition: Official estimate for the 1900 exposition as reported in 1911. The reference day is unknown. Fifteen provincial values and the separately printed Galápagos value sum to 1,197,200. Oriente is blank. The 302,800 difference has no territorial allocation in the source.
